# Product data visualization

Read for charts, plots, or graphs inside the product. Grafana operations dashboards belong to
`obs-dashboards`.

- Choose the mark from the question: time series → line, category comparison → bar, distribution →
  histogram/box plot, relationship → scatter. Avoid part-to-whole charts that hide comparison.
- Label units, time zone, aggregation, missing data, and uncertainty. Do not imply continuity or
  precision the source does not have.
- Match the repository's chart library and theme. Select SVG, canvas, WebGL, downsampling, or
  virtualization from measured points/update rate and interaction/accessibility needs—not a universal
  point threshold or preferred vendor.
- Bound live windows and batch redraws. A stream tick must not force an unbounded render or history.
- Do not rely on color alone. Provide an accessible summary and, when users need exact values, a
  table/download alternative.
